domain_restrictions: m and r are positive integers.
The vector x has length m and all entries are nonnegative.
Nonincreasing means x_1 is at least x_2, x_2 is at least x_3, and so on through x_m.
Nondecreasing means x_1 is at most x_2, x_2 is at most x_3, and so on through x_m.
Nonconstant means not all entries of x are equal.
A sign string t has length r and each entry is either plus one or minus one.
For y of length ell, U(y) and D(y) each have length ell plus 1.
The text does not explicitly state which sign corresponds to U and which corresponds to D, although an intended convention is required for T_t.
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For a nonnegative length-m vector x, the maximum possible total after applying r successive choices between the two sum-expansion operators is achieved by the alternating sign pattern. When x is nonincreasing, the maximizing pattern is the alternating string starting with plus one; when x is nondecreasing, the maximizing pattern is the alternating string starting with minus one. If x is not constant, this maximizer is unique in each case.
quantifier_order: Fix positive integers m and r.
For every vector y of length ell, U(y) and D(y) are defined by the stated prefix-sum and suffix-sum formulas, with empty sums equal to 0.
For every sign string t of length r, T_t is formed by successive application of U or D according to the signs in t.

For every nonnegative vector x of length m, if x is nonincreasing then for every sign string t of length r, Total(T_t(x)) is at most Total(T_Alt_r_plus(x)); if x is nonconstant, equality holds exactly when t is Alt_r_plus.

For every nonnegative vector x of length m, if x is nondecreasing then for every sign string t of length r, Total(T_t(x)) is at most Total(T_Alt_r_minus(x)); if x is nonconstant, equality holds exactly when t is Alt_r_minus.

In the equality clauses, the only specified sign string is the alternating one determined solely by r, so the equality case is a uniqueness claim about t rather than a witness-existence claim.

statement_nl: Fix positive integers m and r. Define U, D, T_t, Total, Alt_r^+, and Alt_r^- exactly as follows: if y=(y_1,...,y_ell), then U(y) and D(y) are length ell+1 vectors given by U(y)_j = sum_{i=1}^{j-1} y_i and D(y)_j = sum_{i=j}^{ell} y_i for 1 <= j <= ell+1, with empty sums equal to 0; for a sign string t=(t_1,...,t_r) with each t_q in {+1,-1}, T_t(x) is obtained by applying U or D successively according to the signs; Alt_r^+=(+1,-1,+1,-1,...) and Alt_r^-=(-1,+1,-1,+1,...) have length r; and Total(y) is the sum of the entries of y. Let x be a nonnegative vector of length m. If x is nonincreasing, then for every sign string t of length r, Total(T_t(x)) <= Total(T_{Alt_r^+}(x)). If x is nonconstant, equality holds if and only if t = Alt_r^+. If x is nondecreasing, then for every sign string t of length r, Total(T_t(x)) <= Total(T_{Alt_r^-}(x)). If x is nonconstant, equality holds if and only if t = Alt_r^-.
